source: Diurnal pp. 250-251: ferial chapters and antiphons begin after Lent I. Easter -42 is Lent I; Sunday exclusion makes the first applicable day Monday.
Diurnal pp. 246, 248, 250-251: direct versicles begin on Lent I (Easter -42), including Sundays.
Diurnal pp. 274-275: ferial chapters after Passion Sunday through Holy Wednesday. Easter -14 is Passion Sunday; -3 is Holy Thursday, excluded.
Diurnal pp. 274-275: these antiphons serve ferias of Passion week; Holy Week takes the occurrent Lauds antiphons. Easter -7 is Palm Sunday, excluded.
Diurnal pp. 272-275, 280: direct versicles from Passion Sunday through Holy Wednesday (Easter -14 inclusive to -3 exclusive). Proper/common precedence is unchanged.
Diurnal pp. 372-374: ferial chapters begin on Monday after Low Sunday (Easter +8). Sundays and feasts keep their own appointments.
